name: YayReviews – Advanced Customer Reviews for WooCommerce
author: YayCommerce

sections.description:
YayReviews is the WooCommerce advanced reviews plugin that helps you collect more customer reviews through automated reminders and rewards.

It also enhances product reviews on your storefront to build trust and drive conversions:

  • Allow image upload
  • Allow video upload
  • Limit the number of images/videos per review
  • Limit filesize
  • Limit min/max number of characters per review
  • Add a checkbox for terms and privacy consent before posting reviews

This plugin is perfect for stores looking to polish their product ratings and gather genuine customer feedback.

Key Features:
– 📬 Automatically send review reminder emails after purchase
– ⏱ Set a custom delay before sending reminders (e.g., 3 days after order completion)
– 🧠 Smart logic to avoid sending duplicate reminders
– 📝 Customizable email content and personalized with email tags
– 💝 Send coupons to those qualified review writers (Pro)
– 💼 Compatible with most themes and WooCommerce setups
– 🔒 Lightweight and GDPR-compliant

All source code, including unminified JS/CSS, is publicly available here:
https://github.com/YayCommerce/yay-reviews

Support

For support and feature requests, please visit our links:

  • YayCommerce support page or contact us directly at support@yaycommerce.com
  • Roadmap & feature requests
  • Documentation
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/yay-customer-reviews-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to YayCommerce → YayReviews to configure your email reminders.
  4. Set the delay time, customize your email message, and enable the reminder system.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin send multiple emails per order?

The free version sends one reminder email per order after a delay you define.

Can I customize the email content?

Yes, you can fully customize the subject and message body using the built-in editor. It’s also easy to personalize using email tags.

Does it support coupons as rewards for leaving reviews?

Yes, YayReviews plugin supports multiple rules for sending coupons based on the submitted review quality.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. YayReviews does not collect or transmit any personal data externally. It comes with a GDPR opt-in consent option to show on the review form on the frontend.
